observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor sports court or hall with spectators seated on bleachers and chairs along the sides
observation.dancers: one young boy and one young girl
observation.formation_and_space: couple dancing together, moving around the center of the court
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting actively between feet
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic stepping and tapping patterns matching the beat, shuffling and light stomping visible in close-ups
observation.arms_and_hands: held in traditional partner embrace/dance hold, shifting between closed and open hand grips
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal isolation, torso moves naturally with the stepping and turning
observation.partnering: closed and semi-closed partner hold, maintaining physical connection and coordinating turns
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level, no jumps, frequent turning rotations together
observation.costume_and_props: boy wears a white suit jacket, white trousers, and a black hat; girl wears a colorful patterned dress with ruffled layers and a flower in her hair
observation.cannot_infer: fast footwork and weight changes are partially obscured by camera distance and low resolution, though visible in close-up cutaways

signature_moments.what: couple begins dancing in closed embrace, stepping in tight circles with coordinated turns
spinning rotation while maintaining close partner hold and rhythmic footwork
partner turn where the girl twirls under the boy's arm while keeping steps synchronized
